fields.name: year
fields.definition: ACS 1-year estimate reference year, 2006-2011

fields.name: puma
fields.definition: Five-character Census 2000 PUMA code; preserve leading zero

fields.name: puma_short
fields.definition: Two-character shorthand 01-10; use puma for joins

fields.name: state_fips
fields.definition: 36 = New York

fields.name: county_fips
fields.definition: 061 = New York County (Manhattan)

fields.name: borough
fields.definition: Manhattan

fields.name: boundary_vintage
fields.definition: 2000 for all years; no 2010/2020 PUMA boundaries

fields.name: map_geoid
fields.definition: 36 + puma; join GeoJSON properties.GEOID or feature.id

fields.name: acs_geoid
fields.definition: 79500US36 + puma; ACS geography identifier

fields.name: region
fields.definition: Project groups: Uptown 03801-03806; Midtown 03807-03808; Downtown 03809-03810

fields.name: stusab
fields.definition: NY; normalized to upper case

fields.name: logrecno
fields.definition: Seven-character annual geography record number; only join within its own year

fields.name: housing_units
fields.definition: B25001_001E; occupied plus vacant housing stock, not new construction

fields.name: housing_units_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for housing_units; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: median_gross_rent
fields.definition: B25064_001E; annual current-dollar median gross rent, including applicable utilities

fields.name: median_gross_rent_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for median_gross_rent; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: median_gross_rent_status
fields.definition: ok, top_coded_ge_2000, bottom_coded_le_100, or unavailable-cell reason. Positive median jam codes are not exact dollar values

fields.name: median_gross_rent_lower_bound
fields.definition: Exact rent when available; 2000 for a 2001 top-code. Not a confidence bound

fields.name: median_gross_rent_upper_bound
fields.definition: Exact rent when available; null means no finite published upper bound for a top-coded median. Not a confidence bound

fields.name: median_gross_rent_display
fields.definition: Exact dollar number, >=2000, <=100, or empty when unavailable

fields.name: cash_rent_households
fields.definition: B25070_001E; cash-rent renter-occupied housing units, including Not computed

fields.name: cash_rent_households_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for cash_rent_households; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households
fields.definition: B25070_011E; retained, never treated as unburdened

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for rent_not_computed_households; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: rent_computable_households
fields.definition: B25070_001E - B25070_011E; rent-burden denominator

fields.name: rent_burdened_households
fields.definition: Sum B25070_007E through B25070_010E; gross rent at least 30% of income

fields.name: rent_burden_pct
fields.definition: 100 * rent_burdened_households / rent_computable_households

fields.name: rent_burden_status
fields.definition: ok, missing_inputs or zero_denominator

fields.name: data_complete
fields.definition: All 13 estimates are exact numeric values and burden ratio available; comparison also requires nonzero growth bases. Censored rent rows remain in both tables with bounds. MOE availability is recorded separately in data_flags

fields.name: data_flags
fields.definition: Pipe-separated unavailable-cell/derived-value reasons; empty string means no flags

fields.name: base_year
fields.definition: Always 2006; never the preceding year

fields.name: end_year
fields.definition: Selected comparison endpoint: 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010 or 2011

fields.name: years_elapsed
fields.definition: end_year - 2006; growth is cumulative, not annualized

fields.definition: B25001_001E; occupied plus vacant housing stock, not new construction At 2006 baseline.

fields.definition: B25001_001E; occupied plus vacant housing stock, not new construction At end_year.

fields.name: housing_units_moe90_end
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for housing_units; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio. At end_year.

fields.name: median_gross_rent_moe90_end

fields.name: cash_rent_households_base
fields.definition: B25070_001E; cash-rent renter-occupied housing units, including Not computed At 2006 baseline.

fields.name: cash_rent_households_end
fields.definition: B25070_001E; cash-rent renter-occupied housing units, including Not computed At end_year.

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households_base
fields.definition: B25070_011E; retained, never treated as unburdened At 2006 baseline.

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households_end
fields.definition: B25070_011E; retained, never treated as unburdened At end_year.

fields.name: rent_computable_households_base
fields.definition: B25070_001E - B25070_011E; rent-burden denominator At 2006 baseline.

fields.name: rent_computable_households_end
fields.definition: B25070_001E - B25070_011E; rent-burden denominator At end_year.

fields.name: rent_burdened_households_base
fields.definition: Sum B25070_007E through B25070_010E; gross rent at least 30% of income At 2006 baseline.

fields.name: rent_burdened_households_end
fields.definition: Sum B25070_007E through B25070_010E; gross rent at least 30% of income At end_year.

fields.name: rent_burden_pct_base
fields.definition: 100 * rent_burdened_households / rent_computable_households At 2006 baseline.

fields.name: rent_burden_pct_end
fields.definition: 100 * rent_burdened_households / rent_computable_households At end_year.

fields.name: housing_units_change
fields.definition: housing_units_end - housing_units_base; net stock estimate difference

fields.name: housing_growth_pct
fields.definition: 100 * (housing_units_end - housing_units_base) / housing_units_base

fields.name: median_gross_rent_change_nominal_usd
fields.definition: median_gross_rent_end - median_gross_rent_base

fields.name: rent_growth_nominal_pct
fields.definition: 100 * (median_gross_rent_end - median_gross_rent_base) / median_gross_rent_base

fields.name: rent_growth_nominal_pct_lower_bound
fields.definition: 100 * (rent_end_lower_bound / rent_base_upper_bound - 1); equals exact growth when both rents are exact. Bound from top/bottom coding, not a confidence limit

fields.name: rent_growth_nominal_pct_upper_bound
fields.definition: 100 * (rent_end_upper_bound / rent_base_lower_bound - 1); null means no finite computable bound. Not a confidence limit

fields.name: rent_growth_status
fields.definition: exact, lower_bound, upper_bound, interval, unavailable; never draw a lower bound as an unqualified exact point

fields.name: rent_burden_change_pp
fields.definition: rent_burden_pct_end - rent_burden_pct_base; not a percentage growth rate

fields.name: data_complete
fields.definition: All 13 estimates are exact numeric values and burden ratio available; comparison also requires nonzero growth bases. Censored rent rows remain in both tables with bounds. MOE availability is recorded separately in data_flags

fields.name: data_flags
fields.definition: Pipe-separated unavailable-cell/derived-value reasons; empty string means no flags

storage.csv: UTF-8 with BOM; unavailable numeric values are empty fields; import identifiers as text in Excel
storage.json: UTF-8 without BOM; identifiers are strings, numeric missing values are null
storage.percentage_precision: Percentages are stored on a 0-100 scale, rounded to 6 decimal places. Do not multiply by 100 again.
storage.uncertainty: Published input MOEs are retained. Derived burden/growth MOEs are not calculated; do not reuse input MOEs as derived uncertainty.
